title: leonurus cardiaca subsp. villosus
intro: Leonurus cardiaca subsp. villosus, commonly known as the Hairy Heartleaf, is a subspecies of the Heartleaf plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including cardiovascular issues, due to its potential health benefits such as lowering blood pressure, improving circulation, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Leonurus cardiaca subsp. villosus include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, such as leonurine and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
